name: a large animal pretending to be furniture
description: Something the size and shape of a bench is here, and it is warm, and it is breathing.
looks: It has been holding this shape for a while.
It rises and falls, and the rhythm is not yours yet.
Sitting on it would be accepted rather than permitted.
says: You can sit. I do not mind the weight.
Breathe with me. You already are.
